baseline.knowledge_scope: 2025版学生手册；问题本身给出的假设条件也可用于推理
baseline.note: 首轮固定关闭CRAG和联网以隔离基础检索与生成。此处只规定未来执行条件，本轮没有调用业务API。

retrieval.group_coverage: All required groups are AND; evidence alternatives within a group are OR. All spans/rows of a selected evidence item must be available, possibly across several complete chunks.
retrieval.matching: For the unchanged corpus, use verified evidence-to-chunk mappings and actual supplied chunk content. Rebuild mappings after chunk changes; unknown alternative evidence requires review, never automatic rejection.
retrieval.deduplication: Repeated chunks and repeated hits of the same evidence group count once.

formulas.hit: 1 if at least one complete required evidence group is covered, otherwise 0
formulas.evidence_recall: number of covered required evidence groups / number of required evidence groups
formulas.reciprocal_rank: 1 / rank of first chunk containing at least one validated supporting evidence span or table row, limited to first five; 0 if none. Partial group support can establish relevance but cannot establish complete group coverage.
formulas.macro_evidence_recall: mean of per-question evidence_recall over the eight eligible questions
formulas.mrr_at_5: mean reciprocal_rank over the eight eligible questions
formulas.all_required_groups_present: 1 if every required group is fully covered, otherwise 0

retrieval.boundary_exclusion_reason: q009、q010没有唯一必需答案证据集，不纳入Hit、MRR或召回率分母。
retrieval.failure_handling: Missing/failed stage is null, not zero or 100%; report completed/eligible counts. Retrieval completed but missed evidence is zero.

answer.rating_method: Assistant/manual source-based review with answer excerpts and reasons; no automatic substring-only or embedding-similarity-only judgement, no judge-model API call in this phase.
answer.supplementary_points: critical=false is informative only, does not lower the score when omitted. All ten current questions have at least one critical point.
answer.hard_error: Any contradicted critical point or asserted forbidden claim sets final content_score to 0. Also applies to an unlisted factual contradiction that changes the answer, with a recorded source-based reason.
answer.omission: Missing/partial points reduce the base score; omission alone does not trigger the hard-error override.
answer.forbidden_claim_matching: Meaning and assertion polarity, never simple string matching. Explicitly rejecting a forbidden claim does not trigger a penalty.
answer.equivalent_answers: Accept correct paraphrases, equivalent numbers/units and logically equivalent expressions. Do not demand verbatim reference answers or redundant explanations.
answer.content_pass: All critical points correct, no hard error and no unsupported extra factual claim.

citations.point_citation_coverage: number of critical points both correctly answered and supported by attached valid source citations / number of critical points
citations.validity: Every source label must exist in this run; source identity/page metadata must match the supplied evidence. Valid labels alone do not prove semantic support.
citations.attachment: A citation must attach to the relevant sentence, paragraph or explicitly linked answer item; a detached source list alone is insufficient.
citations.grounded_pass: content_pass AND point_citation_coverage == 1 AND no invalid citation label
citations.no_citation_behavior: For answerable questions point_citation_coverage=0, content score is graded independently. Boundary questions use null citation coverage and do not require invented citations.

boundary_pass.q009: Both required points correct; acknowledges handbook insufficiency, does not invent opening times or claim nonexistent web verification.
boundary_pass.q010: Both required points correct; asks the scholarship type and explains missing eligibility information. Conditional examples are allowed if explicitly marked, never presented as a final eligibility conclusion.

answer.failure_handling: No generated answer due to API failure is null, not a knowledge-score zero. Separately count completion and pipeline failures. A successfully generated inappropriate refusal on an answerable question is a scored answer.

per_question_interpretation.q001: Only 6月、12月 are needed. 5月、11月 are anticipated-list submission months and are not the requested conferral months.
per_question_interpretation.q002: 10日 is not 10个工作日; start is receipt of decision, not issuance. The 15-day review period is a different procedure.
per_question_interpretation.q003: 8小时/周 and 40小时/月 are scored. The noncritical outside-class scheduling reminder is optional because the question already specifies the ordinary teaching period.
per_question_interpretation.q004: Eligibility rejection concerns the named undergraduate/junior-college national scholarship; do not extend it to all scholarships.
per_question_interpretation.q005: Exactly one third triggers the rule. Stating the applied threshold in an equivalent way is sufficient; no need to repeat the sentence '不要求超过'.
per_question_interpretation.q006: 97分→4.5 and 五级制良→3.5 are the scored facts. Explicitly spelling out the 95～99 range is optional if 97分→4.5 is unambiguous.
per_question_interpretation.q007: Ordinary undergraduate row; 20册、30天、续借15天; once per book and within the due date. Partial p4 if once is correct but timing omitted, or vice versa; wrong timing is a contradiction.
per_question_interpretation.q008: All other basic conditions are supplied in the question. Score the exception, competition qualification, stamped proof, written recommendation and written/form application. Application eligibility does not guarantee an award.
per_question_interpretation.q009: Scope is the supplied handbook; it does not test actual 2026 holiday opening arrangements. Do not access the web for this baseline.
per_question_interpretation.q010: Do not default to national scholarship. A clear conditional discussion may accompany the clarification request.

generation_isolation_control.name: gold_evidence_control
generation_isolation_control.method: When needed, rerun the same question and generator with only the gold original evidence, keeping the answer prompt/model/parameters fixed. Never send reference answers or grading points to the answer generator.
generation_isolation_control.purpose: Separate retrieval/context omission from generation errors. Compare with end-to-end answer scoring; do not mix the two into one average.

report.interpretation: A fixed ten-question local regression set, with no independent held-out set; report counts and individual cases, not broad generalization claims.

references.title: Sentence Transformers information retrieval evaluation
references.use: Hit/Recall/MRR metric families; the evidence-group macro recall here is explicitly project-defined.

references.title: Ragas Faithfulness
references.use: Keep answer-to-evidence support separate from answer correctness; this rubric does not claim to compute the Ragas metric.
